Jamal Rivera: SRE can cover infra readiness and rollback hooks. prefer morning PT.

• Wed 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET
• Wed 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET
• Wed 16:00 PT / 19:00 ET (APAC-friendly)
Pick which works for you, we’ll pick the majority.

```
1) Quick roll status (5m)
2) Canary owners smoke plan + gating metrics (10m)
3) DB migrations / FF toggles + timing (5m)
4) SRE readiness & rollback steps (5m)
5) Final owners + questions (5m)
```

Jamal Rivera: Add a line for dependency check: downstream services and downstream deploy windows.
Maya Patel: Please add a short pre-cut checklist item list in the invite so QA can prep.

Maya Patel: +1
Jamal Rivera: +1
Taylor (release-manager): go for it.
